title: Multi-context seeds enable fast and high-accuracy read mapping

split.decision: Hold out complete existing SIM4 and SIM6 libraries. Both use existing default-seed simulations and may share origin draws; independent secret per-split ID salts prevent enumerable name joins. Fixed CHM13 reference public; origins separate.

baseline.paper_ref: Historical SIM6 mapping accuracy 85.0746%, tool mapping time 15.9 s at 12 threads; not newly measured.

conversion.origin_id_isolation: independent secret random salts per split; operator-only

allowed_changes: mapping/indexing algorithms, alignment scoring and computational representations
implementation and internal heuristics operating on the same observed inputs

When retaining the supplied mapper, changing only -S=0.5, -M=20, -R=100, -f=0.0002, --mcs=always, -H=50, --gd=0.1, --gl=0.05, --vp=0.7, --sg=10000, --mw=0.01, -A=2, -B=8, -O=12, -E=1, -L=10 or --nams off does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Map the existing human reads to the supplied reference and maximize the original all-read interval-overlap accuracy.
